description: Calculation only: needs no model and changes nothing. Turns a slab's bar arrangement into the capacities the RC Slab & Shell Assessment routes need, with the plugin's own core. Use it to check a reinforcement layout by hand, or to see the capacities slab_assess will derive when given the same bars; to assess a model's plate forces use slab_assess (slab_explain_location for one element), and for a beam section cs455_assess. Give thickness_mm, fck and at least one face (top / bottom: cover_mm and one layer per bar direction); partial factors default to γc 1.5, γs 1.15, αcc 0.85, fyk 500 MPa. Returns per layer area, d, x, z, moment capacity (kNm/m) and force (kN/m), plus `assess` — ready to pass on: the Denton/Wood-Armer capacity pairs (top/bottom), the four Annex LL steel forces and the covers to the reinforcement centroid.

inputSchema.description: The bar arrangement (preferred): drives the Denton/Wood-Armer capacities, the Annex LL steel forces and covers, and CS 455.

alpha_cc.description: Long-term coefficient αcc on fck for the flexural capacities (default 0.85, UK NA).

bottom.description: One face: {cover_mm, layers: [{dia, spacing, angle, outer}, ...]} — one layer per bar direction, the outer one marked outer: true.

cover_mm.description: nominal cover to the bar face, mm

angle.description: bar direction, degrees from the reinforcement x direction (0 or alphaDeg)

outer.description: the outer layer of its face
